howTitle.en: Why area ÷ tile area is wrong
howTitle.zh: 为什么面积除以砖面积是错的

howP.en: Dividing floor area by tile area gives you a fraction, and tiles come in whole pieces. A 4.2×3.6 m floor with 600 mm tiles needs 8 columns and 7 rows — 56 tiles — because the last column is a 200 mm sliver that still consumes a full tile. That rounding is usually 3–6% on its own, on top of the breakage allowance you add separately.
howP.zh: 用面积除以砖面积会得到一个小数，但砖只能整片买。4.2×3.6 的房间铺 600 的砖，需要 8 列 7 行共 56 片，因为最后一列只有 200mm 宽，却同样吃掉一整片。这个进位本身通常就占 3–6%，再叠加你另外算的损耗率。

q.en: How much waste should I allow?

a.en: 5–8% for a straight lay in a simple rectangular room. 10–15% for diagonal or herringbone, and more if the room has many corners, a diagonal wall or you are continuing through doorways. Always buy from one batch — a second order can be a different dye lot.
a.zh: 简单矩形房间正铺留 5–8%。斜铺、人字拼留 10–15%，阴阳角多、有斜墙、要过门洞连铺的再多留。务必一次买够同一批次——补货很容易是另一个色号。

q.en: Do I need to add the grout joint to the tile size?
q.zh: 要不要把缝加到砖尺寸里？

a.en: Yes, every tile occupies its size plus one joint. Ignoring a 2 mm joint across 7 tiles is 14 mm — often exactly the amount that turns a 199 mm cut into a 185 mm one, and you would not notice until the last row.
a.zh: 要，每片砖实际占的是砖宽加一条缝。7 片累计忽略 2mm 缝就是 14mm，往往正好把 199mm 的收边变成 185mm，而你要铺到最后一行才发现。

a.en: The default ¥18/m² is a material cost for a 3–5 mm notched trowel bed, which suits most porcelain up to 600×600. Large-format tiles need a thicker bed and back-buttering — expect 1.5–2× that.
a.zh: 默认 18 元/㎡ 对应 3–5mm 齿形刮板，适合 600×600 以内的瓷质砖。大板要更厚的胶层还要背涂，按 1.5–2 倍算。
